The dried resinous exudate obtained from stems and branches of Pistacia lentiscus var. latifolius. It con- tains a minimum of 1% v/w of essential oil, calculated with ref- erence to the anhydrous drug. It should not be powdered. Profile Solutions of mastic in alcohol, chloroform, or ether have been used, applied on cotton wool, as temporary fillings for carious teeth. Compound Mastic Paint (BP 1980) was formerly used as a protective covering for wounds and to hold gauze in position. Mastic gum has been used in the management of peptic ulcer disease. Peptic ulcer disease.
